exercises.sentence: Es en la cámara de eco _____ la desinformación circula con mayor rapidez.
exercises.english: It is in the echo chamber that disinformation circulates most rapidly.

exercises.sentence: La moderación de contenidos es lo que genera mayor debate cuando se busca proteger la veracidad.
options: Content moderation is what generates the greatest debate when seeking to protect truthfulness.
Content moderation is what generates the least debate when seeking to protect truthfulness.
Synthetic content is what generates the greatest debate when seeking to protect truthfulness.
Content moderation is what generates the greatest debate when seeking to protect privacy.

exercises.sentence: Sin un proceso claro de _____, resulta difícil distinguir una noticia real del contenido sintético.
exercises.english: Without a clear verification process, it is hard to distinguish a real news story from synthetic content.

template.prompt: Using an inverted pseudo-cleft with 'es lo que', write one sentence saying that verification (la verificación) is what protects truthfulness (protege la veracidad).
template.answer: La verificación es lo que protege la veracidad.

exercises.question: Which prepositional cleft correctly keeps the preposition and uses *donde* in careful writing?
